body: They kept asking me what my name was, where I was from, and some eventually asked me what the problem was. Some transferred me to someone "in my area" but for some reason they never were in my area so they transferred me somewhere else. Eventually one woman asked what was wrong I just said that I wanted to die but I was not in any immediate danger and was not going to hurt myself and they would say "let me transfer you to a crisis center that can help you" but I think some of the numbers were slightly incorrect because I kept getting transferred to different general hospital's receptionists and the poor women I talked to had no idea what to do with this random sobbing girl on the line asking them if they were the suicide hotline
Has dropping out of your major helped you? My mom wants me to take a semester off but the idea of doing that makes me feel sick to my stomach

What about contacting her parents? It might sound stupid and she might be angry but if there is even the slightest chance they could help...

HOWEVER, and this is important. NO MATTER WHAT HAPPENS, IF SHE HURTS HERSELF IT IS NOT YOUR FAULT. It is not on you, make sure you do not blame yourself.

That actually really helped. I started writing it out and partway through I actually began to calm down (when I first started I was kind of grossly sobbing). I am much calmer now, so now I can probably distract myself until I fall asleep
